description: Render a red giant star with a larger radius and orange-red color palette — demonstrates how to simulate different stellar classes.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Star

class StarRedGiant(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        star = Star(
            radius=0.9,
            num_of_particles=800,
            size_of_particle=0.006,
            colors=[RED, ORANGE],
            temperature=3500,
        )
        star.move_to(ORIGIN)
        label = Text("Red Giant", font_size=28).next_to(star, DOWN)
        self.add(star, label)
        self.wait(0.5)
